text: 66-year-old white male. The patient reports a 10-day history of fatigue and bilateral lower leg swelling. He mentions a weight loss of 3.6 kg (8 lbs) over the past 6 months without trying. He has a history of chronic bronchitis and uses an albuterol inhaler as needed.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful. Given your age and the combination of fatigue, significant weight loss, and leg swelling, have you experienced any shortness of breath, chest pain, or decreased urine output recently?

text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have Lower leg swelling, Unintentional weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Renal Cell Carcinoma with metastatic disease causing paraneoplastic syndrome (SIADH or hyperviscosity) and renal vein thrombosis leading to nephrotic syndrome.
